title: The Bouquet I Made For You

flowers.title: The Bookstore
content: The story started in Tehran. Not with a grand romantic moment. Not with fireworks. Not with fate announcing itself.
In a bookstore.
You took a photo of me. Then you sent it to me.
At the time, I thought: 'She seems warm. She seems friendly.'
Meanwhile you apparently thought I was gay.
A surprisingly strong foundation for a relationship.
A bookstore became the first chapter. Maybe that is why books keep appearing in our story.

flowers.title: Who You Are
content: You are kind. You are funny. You are beautiful. You are brave.
When something matters to you, you fight for it. You fight for your rights. You refuse to disappear quietly.
One of the things I admire most is that you keep moving forward. Even when life becomes difficult. Even when the future feels uncertain.
Recently you started taking barista classes. Recently you started taking IELTS classes. You are actively building a future for yourself.
Not because the road is easy. Because you keep going anyway.

flowers.title: The Tiny Things
content: One of the most important memories is not a trip. Not a milestone. Not a dramatic event.
It is when you send me videos of yourself taking your medication.
To most people this would seem insignificant.
To me it means: You are here. You are okay. You are taking care of yourself.
And somehow that matters more than I can explain.

flowers.title: What We Survived
content: A terrible fight. One that hurt. One that tested us.
One that reminded us that loving someone is not the same thing as understanding them.
And yet we stayed. And we worked through it. And we kept choosing each other.
We also survived two wars. Not metaphorically. Actual wars.
Because surviving difficult times together changed the way we think about life. It made ordinary moments matter more.
A coffee. A walk. A hand held on a boat. A conversation. A future. These things became precious.

flowers.title: The Cat Museum
content: Two cat lovers doing exactly what two cat lovers would do.
A memory that feels almost inevitable. Two cats visiting cats.
This is who we are.

flowers.title: The Boat Trip
content: The thing I remember most is not the destination. Not the water. Not the scenery. Not the photographs.
Holding your hand.
That is the memory that survived.

flowers.title: The Escape Room
content: You got scared.
I probably enjoyed this more than I should have.
A memory filled with laughter.
The kind of moment I want to remember forever.

flowers.title: Valentine's Day Cigars
content: An unusual Valentine's Day. Not flowers. Not cliches.
Cigars.
A memory that somehow feels perfectly us.

flowers.title: The Fight
content: One of the hardest moments was a fight that forced us to ask uncomfortable questions.
Why do we love each other? What are we holding onto? What are we afraid of losing?
We learned that love can come from different places. Sometimes love comes from fear.
But we also discovered something else. There is another kind of love. A quieter kind. A healthier kind.
The kind that says: 'I want you to become who you are meant to become.' Not because I need you. But because your happiness genuinely matters to me.

flowers.title: Your Dreams
content: You dream of opening a bookstore. Becoming a therapist. Helping people. Building something meaningful.
These dreams are not just words. They are who you are becoming.
I watch you work toward them every day. That takes courage. That takes hope.
I believe in those dreams. I believe in you.

flowers.title: The Old Cats
content: One of my favorite thoughts: Many years from now.
An old sofa. Music playing. A room filled with books. Evening light coming through the window.
You and me, sitting together. Older. A little slower. Still talking. Still laughing.
Still sharing cigarettes. Still surviving the world together.
Not because life became perfect. Because we stayed. Because we built something worth staying for.

flowers.title: The Most Important Line
content: Thanks for making your arms a safe place for me to put down my guard.
Everything else in our story grows around this sentence.
This sentence is home. This sentence is trust. This sentence is peace.
This sentence is the reason I am writing this.

finalLetter.title: The Bouquet
content: This bouquet is a collection of moments. Some big. Some small. All ours.
Each flower is a letter. Each letter is a piece of our story.
The bookstore where it started. The cat museum where we did what cat lovers do. The boat where I held your hand. The escape room where you got scared and I laughed. The cigars on Valentine's Day.
The fight that taught us love is a choice. The wars we survived. The tiny video of you taking your medication that somehow means everything.
Your dreams. My dreams. Our dreams of a quieter life, built together.
The old cats we will become, sitting on a sofa full of books, listening to music, still talking, still laughing.
Everything grows around one sentence: Thanks for making your arms a safe place for me to put down my guard.
This website is not a celebration of dependency. It is a celebration of admiration. It is a reminder that I am proud of who you are becoming.
I hope you keep becoming that person.
Whether the road is easy or difficult.
And when I imagine the future, Ela, you are already there.
That is what love looks like.
This bouquet is my love letter to you. To us. To the story we are writing together.
Every flower is a chapter. Every petal is a moment. Every stem is a promise.
I love you.
With all my love, Sahand
To Ela, my Nini.
